Uplink IT Academy

From help desk to network engineer, taught the way the job works.

Visit academy.lemonshops.app →How to use itWatch the purpose

I

Purpose

Shorten the distance between a certificate and the first day of work. Every exam question is written as a ticket, every lab is a device you can break and fix, and the help desk simulator is a real queue with real tools.

II

The problem

People study from question dumps and slide decks, then freeze on their first real ticket. The gap between what is tested and what is done is where careers stall.

III

What I built

Seven rooms in one platform. Practice sets of two hundred original scenario questions, each with a full explanation and a link to learn more. A Ticket Simulator with a queue, directory, server room, remote desktop, mail admin and asset tools. A Network Lab with Windows, Linux, security and Cisco consoles. A Troubleshooting Coach, a Career Agent, and Network Docs, where a customer orders drawn documentation of a real site.

IV

How it works

Labs are described as data: a device, a scripted shell, a list of checks. A grader replays the model solution through the same logic the learner's console uses, and a lab is published only when the grader passes. A scheduled builder adds one lab per track each day from a backlog of topics.

V

Craft

Warm editorial palette, a serif that reads like a textbook, a monospace voice for anything a terminal says. Mobile first. Payments through Stripe.

VI

The purpose, in motion

A short motion design made for this book: four beats, one drawn shape each, the reason the project exists. Tap it to step through.

In short
